bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Youth and Family Circle for outdoor programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATIONS; YOUTH AND FAMILY CIRCLE OUTDOOR PROGRAMS. +]

[+$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to Youth and Family Circle for outdoor programs for youth to celebrate Minnesota's outdoor culture and heritage. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Youth and Family Circle for outdoor programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; YOUTH AND FAMILY CIRCLE OUTDOOR PROGRAMS.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to Youth and Family Circle for outdoor programs for youth to celebrate Minnesota's outdoor culture and heritage.
additions: APPROPRIATIONS; YOUTH AND FAMILY CIRCLE OUTDOOR PROGRAMS.
